english.note: Use 節目 as the all-purpose noun for a television or radio program.
Use this for a show or program put on for people to watch or enjoy.
Use this when “broadcast” means the actual radio or TV programme rather than its transmission.
Use this for the programming or entertainment offered by a television or radio channel.
